verdict.rationale: Community reports show macOS ships first-party command-line utilities such as pbcopy/pbpaste, networkQuality, fs_usage and /usr/bin/stapler, which users chain in terminal workflows, so an official CLI surface clearly exists. The evidence comes only from community anecdotes, though, and nothing ties these tools to agent or AI-native use. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of the CLI tooling, any AI- or agent-oriented CLI workflow, and a unified, documented CLI for automating OS features such as Shortcuts or Siri AI actions.
